name: semantic
description: Graph + opt-in LOCAL semantic/vector layer (sqlite-vec + fastembed, BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384-dim). Still LOCAL/zero-egress (local embedder). Requires `pip install revien[semantic]`; when the extra is absent the bench refuses to run (exit 3) unless --allow-degraded, and then labels the result DEGRADED.
